profile.headline: Full‑Stack Dev | Designs and builds accessible UIs | Photographer & Creative
profile.summary: Full‑stack developer with a UI specialty. I design in Figma, build in TypeScript, and deliver on AWS with Python CDK and GitLab CI/CD. I’m often pulled into UX discovery and business user sessions to design and develop end‑to‑end UI solutions. I lead UI standards and a reusable component library, mentor through code reviews, write clear stories and acceptance criteria, and drive ongoing domain-adapted LLM integrations into existing applications. I use Amazon Q Developer and Kiro, plus Microsoft Copilot, to move faster without sacrificing maintainability.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop end‑to‑end UI solutions. Meet with business users, run UX discovery, produce Figma mockups, and implement accessible, high‑performing front ends in TypeScript.
• Provide cross‑team UI support during high‑demand periods to help teams hit critical deadlines while maintaining accessibility and performance standards.
• Lead UI standards and maintain a reusable component library aligned with enterprise design systems to speed delivery and keep apps consistent.
• Drive ongoing domain-adapted LLM integrations into existing applications in our AWS environment using secure, maintainable patterns.
• Provision AWS resources with Python‑based CDK (S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudFront) and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for reliable, auditable releases.
• Review merge requests and mentor peers on front‑end best practices, accessibility, and performance.
• Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, keep backlog health visible, and surface risks and dependencies early.
• Use Amazon Q Developer and Kiro, alongside Microsoft Copilot, to accelerate day‑to‑day development while keeping code maintainable.
• Plan and execute social engagement initiatives across the department, focusing on marketing and communications.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
• Provided cross-team support for UI development during high-demand periods, ensuring accessibility and performance standards were met.
• Designed UI enhancements for applications using Figma and contributes to front-end development.
• Maintained and optimized GitLab CI/CD pipelines for code deployment.
• Created foundational resources (S3, KMS, Secrets, etc.) for projects in AWS using Python-based CDK.
• Partnered with UX teams to develop a reusable component library that aligning with enterprise design systems, accelerating delivery while ensuring consistency.
• Serve as department's guide for UI standards and governance, mentoring peers on best practices.
• Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Amazon Q to streamline development workflows, while adhering to best practices to ensure maintainable and high-quality code.
• Collaborates with the Data Analytics team to set up their large language models in our AWS environment using in order to integrate with existing applications.
• Co-lead the Wellbeing workstream of Employee Engagement Committee to promote employee satisfaction across the Software Engineering portfolio.
• Contributor to the DE&I Council's Marketing and Communications workstream, creating accessible graphics and promotional materials.

positions.title: Sports Photographer
positions.description: Minnesota-based photographer focused on dynamic sports imagery and storytelling.
positions.insights: Skills: Sports Photography · Graphic Design · Photo Mechanic · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Lightroom · Social Media

positions.title: Portrait & Wedding Photographer
positions.description:
• Built and maintain a website using Squarespace to function as a portfolio and lead generator. 
• Work in fast-paced environments with multiple vendors as a team to ensure the best possible experience for clients on wedding days. 
• Implement client workflow system to ensure every client receives a high-level experience from first inquiry to delivery of final gallery and retain clientele for future projects. 
• Create color-contrast accessible graphics and advertisements using the Adobe Creative Suite. 
• Developed a streamlined process, ensuring that 500+ client galleries have been delivered within contracted deadlines.
positions.insights: Skills: Portrait Photography · Branding Photo · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Lightroom · Wedding Photography · Headshot Photography · Photo Mechanic

positions.title: Dev10 Associate
positions.description:
• Chosen for highly selective, paid Dev10 training program - less than 5% of applicants are hired.
• Training in Java Cloud.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · SQL · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · MUI · HTML5 · JavaScript · Java

positions.title: Content Creator
positions.description:
• Worked directly with Xbox and other brands to digitally promote products through live streaming and events.
• Established a unique brand that set her apart from other Microsoft Content Providers.
• Maintained a concurrent viewership of 20-50+ viewers each stream.
• Created and maintained a smoothly running, high quality live broadcast using OBS (Open Broadcaster Sofware).
• Utilized Adobe Photoshop to create stream overlays and promotional graphics.
• Promoted content on social media platforms to gain new viewers and maintain relations with community members.

positions.title: Navy Lodge Guest Service Representative
positions.description:
• Provided high level service while being professional and approachable.
• Maintained confidentiality and prioritized safety of guests.
• Exhibited high level customer service and diffusing skills to ease guest concerns when discrepancies arose.

positions.title: Photographer and Social Media Manager
positions.description:
• Photographed and created engaging content to post on social media outlets.
• Developed a posting schedule and task batched content using Hootsuite.
• Photographed the property’s buildings and amenities, spanning 64 acres, for use on the Knights Circle website and promotional materials (post cards, information pamphlets, flyers, etc.) within real estate photography guidelines.
• Regularly checked social media accounts and replied to resident concerns within 1 hour.
